review_boundary.purpose: Repository governance review of rights, redistribution, attribution, and canonical bundling for the four Phase B2A E5_TECHNICAL targets.

insdc.finding: INSDC states that its records are freely and unrestrictedly accessible, that no use restrictions or licensing requirements are included in sequence records, and that no restrictions or licensing fees are placed on redistribution or use of the database. It also assigns responsibility for the right to submit and record accuracy to submitters and asks users to cite the original submission.
insdc.scope: Database-wide access, use, redistribution, permanence, and attribution policy.

ncbi.finding: NCBI places no restrictions of its own on GenBank or molecular-data use and distribution, but warns that submitters or countries of origin may assert patent, copyright, or other rights; no rights transfer to NCBI, so NCBI cannot grant unrestricted third-party permission.
ncbi.scope: NCBI database posture and third-party-rights caveat.

database_policy.combined_rule: INSDC database redistribution policy can support a repository bundling basis only after a separate record-specific screen. It is not a guarantee of freedom to operate, patent non-infringement, copyright status, or product-use clearance.

record_review.basis: Google Patents exact-accession discovery identifies WO2012028646A1, Means for improving agrobiological traits in plants, citing HQ693235.1 as an Arabidopsis UBQ10 promoter sequence. The GenBank submitters and patent applicant context are institutionally related. The discovery does not establish claim scope, validity, jurisdictional status, or an actual restriction on database-record copying.

records.human_review_item: Review the WO2012028646 family and intended product use against the exact 1..636 promoter feature before product admission.

record_review.basis: The GenBank record is a direct submission for Solanum lycopersicum cultivar PT18 and contains no patent, copyright, license, proprietary-construct, commercial-vector, or restriction annotation. Cultivar and geographic-source metadata are descriptive, not a rights statement. Exact-accession Google Patents discovery returned no result and is not exhaustive.

PP558908.1 is a synthetic Level0_hspt construct and has no patent, copyright, license, or restriction annotation. The linked 2024 article is CC BY 4.0; its supplement maps PP558908 to Level0_HSPt and marks that component as created in the study. The article license is not treated as a blanket license for every underlying DNA element. Exact-accession Google Patents discovery returned no result and is not exhaustive.

records.scope_limit: The governance result applies only to the exact annotated 852..1101 (+) feature. It does not clear the complete PP558908.1 plasmid or its other components.

record_review.basis: The GenBank record and linked paper identify herbicide-resistance and plant-transformation use. Google Patents exact-accession discovery identifies patent publications citing X17220.1, including WO2018075507A1 as a known wild-type PAT coding-sequence reference. The discovery is a patent-related reference, not proof that the exact wild-type sequence is covered, enforceable, or restricted from database-record redistribution.

records.human_review_item: Review exact-sequence claims, relevant patent families and jurisdictions, and the intended product-use context before product admission.

required_fields: exact feature coordinates, strand, and feature type
attribution_contract.notice: NCBI/INSDC database policy permits access and redistribution of database records, but NCBI does not receive submitter rights and cannot grant unrestricted third-party permission. Attribution does not represent legal clearance, freedom to operate, biological performance, or formal product admission.
